verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents a built-in AI agent, Phoenix Intelligence, that inspects traces, iterates on prompts and runs experiments. Its first-party remote MCP endpoint also lets clients like Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code search, query and operate on projects, traces, datasets, experiments, prompts and annotations, with a one-line `px setup mcp` command. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of Phoenix Intelligence's natural-language command scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice.
